content.short: Stables is a stablecoin money app and payments platform with virtual accounts, a Visa card and USDt settlement.
content.description: Stables is a global stablecoin money platform, headquartered in Australia, that lets people and businesses hold, save and spend US dollars as regulated stablecoins across more than 150 countries. Consumers get balances backed by USDC and USDT, virtual account details for receiving funds, low-cost cross-border transfers and a Visa card for spending, while its infrastructure and API let fintechs, exchanges and OTC desks collect fiat and settle in stablecoins. Processing more than 2 billion dollars in annual USDt volume across 160-plus markets with SOC 2 certification, Stables focuses on Asia, MENA and other emerging markets, turning digital dollars into a practical global account for consumers and payment companies alike.
